summary.result: By assigning Lagrangian multipliers to certain constraints and relaxing them, the problem separates into two single-commodity network flow problems and an assignment problem, for which efficient algorithms are available.
summary.background: Our interest in this paper is in the efficient computation of a good low bound for the traveling salesman problem and is in the application of a network problem in agriculture.
summary.method: We base our approach on a relatively new formulation of the TSP as a two-commodity network flow problem.
